description: Mobile app subscription cancellations. Key nuance: subscriptions purchased through Apple App Store or Google Play must be managed through the platform, not the app developer.
common_issues: Subscribed through App Store/Play Store but can't find cancellation
App deleted but subscription continues (deleting app does NOT cancel)

email_1.subject: Cancellation and Refund Request — {{company_name}} App Subscription
key_points: Specify whether subscription was through App Store, Play Store, or directly with developer
If subscribed through platform, note that platform cancellation has been completed
Request refund for unauthorized or unwanted charges
mobile_specific_points: CRITICAL: Deleting an app does NOT cancel the subscription
If subscribed via App Store: must cancel in iOS Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions
If subscribed via Google Play: must cancel in Play Store > Subscriptions
If subscribed directly with developer: email/website cancellation

email_2.subject: Follow-Up: App Subscription Cancellation — SECOND REQUEST
key_points: Mention platform dispute process as alternative

email_3.subject: Final Notice: App Subscription — {{company_name}}
key_points: State intent to pursue platform refund and regulatory complaint

apple.name: Apple App Store Refund
apple.cancel_path: iOS: Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions. macOS: App Store > Account > Subscriptions.
apple.refund_process: Go to reportaproblem.apple.com, sign in with Apple ID, find the charge, select 'Request a Refund'. Apple reviews and typically responds within 48 hours.
apple.refund_policy: Apple reviews refund requests on a case-by-case basis. Unauthorized purchases, accidental purchases, and subscriptions that didn't work as described are common approval reasons.
important_notes: Deleting the app does NOT cancel the subscription
You can request a refund even after cancelling the subscription
Family Sharing subscriptions must be cancelled by the organizer
Free trial: cancel before trial ends to avoid being charged

google.name: Google Play Refund
google.cancel_path: Google Play Store > Menu > Subscriptions > Select subscription > Cancel
google.refund_process: Go to play.google.com/store/account/subscriptions, find the subscription, request a refund. Google has a 48-hour refund window for most purchases; after that, contact the developer or Google support.
google.refund_policy: Google generally processes refunds within 48 hours of purchase. For subscriptions older than 48 hours, refunds are at the developer's discretion or can be pursued through Google support.
important_notes: Uninstalling the app does NOT cancel the subscription
You can also request refund through Google Pay at pay.google.com
Subscriptions through Google may be eligible for Google's purchase protection

notes: Mobile app subscriptions are the most confusing vertical because of the platform intermediary. The most common issue is people who delete the app thinking the subscription is cancelled. Always determine whether the subscription was through Apple, Google, or directly with the developer — this determines the cancellation and refund path.
